does_not_cover: Shows zero probability calculations despite the title: no PMF evaluated, no table or software use.
Never writes a Bernoulli, binomial, Poisson or hypergeometric formula or moment.
Promises relationships only verbally: no limit derivation, no fitted example, no decision rule for model choice.
notes: Deliberate no-math recap; states upfront it skips calculations. Negative binomial content has no L07 node counterpart. Brisk overview pacing, best used as a map before detail videos.

segments.topic: Scope: recap of how discrete distributions arise, no calculations
Bernoulli trial and binomial count with coin-toss examples
Geometric and negative binomial waiting-time setups contrasted with binomial
Hypergeometric sampling without replacement and binomial approximation
Poisson event counts and large-n small-p binomial approximation
Pointer to dedicated videos for each distribution

suggested_locator: 01:43-03:06 for the fixed-trials vs fixed-successes contrast; 04:48-06:05 for the Poisson link

teaches.why: Frames which setup produces which distribution without computing anything.
Defines single-trial and n-trial success counts with concrete questions.
Defines trials needed for the first success with a coin example.
Defines success counts without replacement and contrasts with independence.
Defines event counts per unit with an accident-count example.
States both approximation links: hypergeometric by binomial, binomial by Poisson.
